No application-specific AOT request caller was found.

findings.repair: Both explicit-profile public hold paths now interrupt the grouped peer before refreshing; main holds also invalidate queued progress targets. Existing bounded hold service, group dispatch suppression, and STOP routing remain in use.
Synchronous cached get_light_state now returns the same is_on shape as read_light_state; the actual HA light observes telemetry and teardown clears cached state before notifying it.
Advanced alarm zero reads hour and minute from the accepted offsets 10 and 11; the distinct accepted 06:30 record is tested for both F23 and kneading profiles.
CB25 record parsing and alarm entities now expose both complete accepted alarm records regardless of outbound maker dialect. The 17-byte packet guard remains.
M1X12 sonic mode and massage-type assignments now use their distinct accepted fields; a vector with unequal field values verifies the labels.
